title: Noeis — Grow a knowledge base from what you read
description: Save articles, highlights and notes, and Noeis grows them into a wiki that cites every source. Ask it questions, or connect your AI agents, and get answers quoted from your own reading.
eyebrow: A knowledge base for you and your AI agents
headline: Grow a knowledge base from what you read.
lede: Noeis keeps every article, highlight and note you save, grows them into a wiki that cites its sources, and lets you and your AI agents learn from it. Answers come from your own reading, with the passage quoted.

statements.title: Save what you read.
statements.copy: Clip articles with the browser extension, paste text, or bring in your Readwise library and Notion pages. Highlights and notes stay with the passage they came from.

statements.title: Grow a wiki that cites itself.
statements.copy: Noeis turns your sources into pages on the subjects you follow. Pages cite the passages they are built from, so you can always check the source.

statements.title: Ask, and get the passage back.
statements.copy: Questions are answered from your library with the exact quote. When your reading has nothing on it, Noeis says so instead of guessing.

statements.title: Let your agents learn from it.
statements.copy: Connect Claude Code, Codex and other agents to your knowledge base. You approve every connection, and access is read-only unless you grant more.
